paragraphs.text: A Maro-Sorcerer (mah-roh ), also known as a Force of Nature , is the elemental manifestation of the land , either brought about by strong magic or of nature's own will.

In Dominaria , it's believed that every forest of any size has a spirit or avatar that keeps the site safe: these creatures can be befriended with the right magic. Dominarian forces of nature — some of which are servants of the Worldsoul, Gaea — are often called "maro". In its original art description, Maro ( Mirage ) was described as "the epitome of the fertility of the fresh ground."

The Calthyn elves and the Kieryn elves fought each other for the privilege to speak with the Great Spirit. Everything it touched as it watched the battle between the Calthyn and Kieryn shriveled and died. It told Jared Carthalion that Ravidel was alive, and that he sought Liana and her Moxen . One Force of Nature was summoned by Dreygar and given the Dark Amulet , but was defeated by Aldon . Another was summoned by Greensleeves . The first Force of Nature to be called a maro-sorcerer was Multani . The maro-sorcerer Sol'Kanar was corrupted into a monster by the planeswalker Geyadrone Dihada so that he might better serve her.

Maro-sorcerers are named after Mark Rosewater , who created Multani and chose the name himself. Although they don't depict Maro-sorcerors, the -maro cycle of legendary creatures in Saviors of Kamigawa was based on the card Maro . Searching for card designs fitting the set's wisdom theme, the set's designers created a cycle based on the Mirage card. Brandon Bozzi , who was in charge of the set's names and flavor texts, decided to incorporate "maro" into the cards' names. Fortunately, -maro (まろ) was already an archaic suffix for male names in Japanese.
